levels.surface: أبي عبد الله جعفر بن محمد الصادق

notes: square brackets «[عن الحسن البزاز]» mark an editor's insertion; the text writes the name inside the chain, so it is read as a link
«أبيه» names no one (relation); the Imam is named inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator, and the words he speaks are his own saying (owner ruling 2)
